name: Sonora
description: A single-file H5 music player. There is no browse-and-buy loop: the world is a transport that is always playing or paused at a position, plus a queue you reorder in place. 10 screens, 6 albums, 28 tracks, 2 seeded playlists, a seek bar with jump marks, tri-state repeat, shuffle, a persistent mini player that follows you across screens, downloads and an explicit-content filter that actually hides tracks. Album covers are generated from each album's palette and style, so there are no image files.

finish.answer: final answer for question tasks; optional for action tasks

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — an accessibility tree with #test-ids. Every screen is prefixed by a transport line (what is playing, where, shuffle/repeat/queue depth), so the player state is legible from anywhere.
observation.pixels: 390x844 screenshot (browser backend); __ENV__.bounds() maps every test-id to a pixel box
observation.state: engine.snapshot(state) — canonical state plus a derived view. For the verifier only.

world.transport: position is in seconds and never advances on its own — only seeking, skipping and starting a new context move it
world.seek: the ±15s buttons step, and the 0/25/50/75% marks jump to an exact fraction of the track
world.repeat: off -> all -> one, cycled by a single control
world.explicit_filter: when on, the two explicit tracks disappear from every list and from playback contexts
